quests.title: Serpent's Heart Inquiry

dialogue.t: My name is...
Aberaku, Helios-Forger!
Um, what's the Helios?
Is it something very impressive?
Verily! T'was I who organized the building of the Helios with the might of an entire nation behind me, that we might resist the Dragonheirs of the Depths.
This unsurpassed deed could have been done by no other in Byakuyakoku — none save I!
Huh. Guess that is pretty impressive.
But why would such a great person be sealed in here?
I... I was betrayed...
When the sky kingdom crashed into the bottomless depths, the people were scourged by dragons, and thus did I — yes, 'twas I — begin building the Helios to save us all from our fate.
But... those ravening rogues! The moment their lives were no longer in danger, they began to deceive and lie. They even advocated placing mere infants on the throne. Laughable!
Even I became the target of their schemes, and was left in jail to rot!
A pox! A pox upon them all!
...Right. You.

dialogue.sit: Paimon, I think he's talking to you.

dialogue.t: Yup, that's you!
It can only be you!
My sacred robes were once placed here, but they have all but rotted away in the passing of years, and can no longer be relied upon.
But if you can pass the test, then I shall hand the offerings, into which I have nested my thoughts, unto you.
I pray for your... success...
This matter is perilous. Tell me once you are ready, O Traveler, and we shall begin.
Are you fully girded up, Traveler?
Then I wish you... every success in your battle ahead.

dialogue.sit: I need a while more to prepare.

dialogue.t: Then I shall await your tidings.
I—Incredible! You may just be able to do this...
Please then, I beg you, carry these offerings... the offerings... you must...
You must take them away to...
To...
What's wrong?
Oh brother, his words are getting less and less clear!
Take them to the place of enshrining... enjoin the parts of my soul, in order to...
Hello, Mr. Spirit?
In order to... In order to...
In order to do what again?
In order to...
Ugh, this guy isn't making himself clear at all! But it seems we're supposed to take these offerings somewhere — Paimon got that much.
These offerings have been here for so long. Who knows if there's anything edible here.

dialogue.sit: Best not to eat them all the same.

dialogue.t: H—Hey! Paimon doesn't just eat anything, alright?
Well, let's take the offerings with us anyway, {NICKNAME}.

quests.description: Clear the trials according to the path prescribed by the spirit named Aberaku and obtain the offerings…
